page.title: Data migration
page.description: Load records from the legacy system one register at a time, in the order below: each register refers only to the registers above it.

DEPARTMENT.name: Departments
DEPARTMENT.description: AHDA's departments and their hierarchy. Active or inactive as in the legacy system.

MASTER_DATA_ITEM.name: Master data items
MASTER_DATA_ITEM.description: Legacy code lists into their catalogues. Imported as drafts: two other administrators validate and publish them before records can use them.

EXTERNAL_ENTITY.name: External entities
EXTERNAL_ENTITY.description: Delivering entities with their type and AHDA sponsor, in their legacy status.

USER.name: Users
USER.description: Internal users linked to the directory and external users of their entity, active or disabled. Role assignments are made afterwards.

KPI_DEFINITION.name: KPI definitions
KPI_DEFINITION.description: The KPI catalogue. Imported as drafts for validation and publication.

PROJECT.name: Projects
PROJECT.description: Projects under way, taken in ACTIVE with their Formal Project ID, manager, declared baseline and opening progress and spend. A manager without R04 is given it on the project.

ROLE_ASSIGNMENT.name: Role assignments
ROLE_ASSIGNMENT.description: Who holds which permission profile, over a department, an entity or an imported project. Loaded after projects.

title: Import {register}
intro: Bring records over from the legacy system. Fill in the template, then check the file: nothing is saved until every row passes.

template.heading: 1. Download the template
template.hint: Required columns are highlighted. The Columns sheet describes each column; the Reference values sheet lists the codes you can use.

file.heading: 2. Choose the filled workbook
file.label: Workbook (.xlsx)
file.hint: Up to 5,000 rows and 10 MB. The first row holds the column names from the template.

report.issues: {issues} problems found. Nothing was imported. Correct the workbook and check it again.
report.ready: All {rows} rows passed: {created} will be created and {skipped} already imported earlier will be skipped.
report.nothingNew: Every row was imported earlier: there is nothing new to import.
report.committed: Imported {created} records. {skipped} rows imported earlier were skipped.
report.caption: Problems found in the workbook

issues.MALFORMED: Not in the expected format (see the Columns sheet).
issues.ENUM_VALUE: Not one of the allowed values.
issues.INVALID_CHARACTER: Contains a character that is not accepted.
issues.COLUMN_MISSING: This required column is missing from the first row.
issues.COLUMN_UNKNOWN: Column not recognised: use the template's column names.
issues.NO_ROWS: The workbook has no rows under the column names.
issues.DUPLICATE_IN_FILE: This legacy ID is already used by an earlier row.
issues.REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND: Nothing with this code or ID exists (see the Reference values sheet).
issues.ALREADY_EXISTS: A record with this value already exists on the platform.
issues.NOT_FOUND: The record it names was not found.
issues.INACTIVE: The record it names is not active.
issues.DUPLICATE: Another record already holds this value.
issues.DATE_BEFORE_START: This date is before the start date.

problems.notWorkbook: The file is not an Excel workbook. Save it as .xlsx and try again.
problems.tooLarge: The workbook is too large. Split it into files of at most 5,000 rows.
